scope: Hash-pinned A1 production Gaussian on the fixed L=16 three-torus, three complex components in the six-real convention, eta_shell=0, fixed rho_regularizer=1e-12, positive production Q_II, exact/dealiased products, and the A7-A10 common real-even sharp rectangular-cube dyadic filtration. The no-go is cutoff asymptotic under the base Gaussian; the determinant theorem is finite-cutoff conditional Gaussian algebra.

convention.complex_mode_covariance: E[Psi_n Psi_n^dagger]=2 A(k_n)^-1; the factor 2 is load-bearing
convention.point_covariance: C_N=(2/V) sum_n A(k_n)^-1 is trace-class in three dimensions for the q^4 production symbol
convention.total_derivative_covariance: Gamma_N^Sigma=sum_i Gamma_i,N; do not insert an additional factor 3
convention.energy_normalisation: q_B(Dphi) and V_j are torus integrals; numerical rows report densities and restore the volume V=L^3 explicitly in the asymptotic statement
convention.reference_local_terms: F_ref uses lambda/4 times int rho^2 and gamma/6 times int rho^3

branch_firewall.rule: The scalar anchor is checked only for non-identity and is never substituted into the full-production covariance.

past_energy_no_go.candidate: E_nu E_J <= alpha_d H(nu|gamma_J)+epsilon_d E_nu||phi_J||_6^6+K_d E_nu||phi_J||_4^4+C_d with constants independent of J
past_energy_no_go.left_asymptotic: For N_j=2^j, E_gamma E_J/(L^3 N_J) -> kappa_II>0 by A6 and marginal consistency.
past_energy_no_go.right_asymptotic: The endpoint L4 and L6 Gaussian moments remain O(1) because C_N converges in trace.

true_increment.operator_data: A_j=M_(B(x_j))^(1/2) G_j, r_j=M_(B(x_j))^(1/2) D x_j, T_j=A_j^*A_j, ell_j=A_j^*r_j=G_j^*B(x_j)D x_j
true_increment.conditional_log_laplace: log E_j exp(-p I_j)=0.5[p Tr T_j-log det(I+pT_j)]+0.5 p^2 <ell_j,(I+pT_j)^-1 ell_j>

proof_order: Register the base-Gaussian no-go for the direct past-energy upper form.
Use I_j to telescope the actual A7 action exactly.
Retain and bound the positive adapted source-square term.
Prove the stabilised relative log-Laplace estimate for theta I_j+C_j.
Reassemble the Nelson budget and only then revisit the interacting measure.

closed: the base-Gaussian contradiction for the A10 past-energy upper-form route
the exact true-increment action telescope at every finite cutoff
the exact noncentral conditional determinant formula
excluded: the adapted source-square or sharp-cube L6 paraproduct estimate
the true-increment stabilised relative log-Laplace estimate
a positive production sextic budget after source allocation
an interacting full three-component Gibbs measure
rho-floor removal, regulator independence, or infinite volume
phase transition, BCC existence or selection, T5, T6, or T7
